title: Systematic and computational identification of Androctonus crassicauda long non-coding RNAs
summary: RNA-seq plus ML-based coding-potential filters produced a first scorpion lncRNA catalog, including 12,642 transcripts without identifiable orthologs; this is a bounded transcriptomic result with computational rather than experimental validation.
ai_technology: Experimental-computational filtering pipeline with CPC2, CNIT and PLEK lncRNA classifiers
organization: Razi Vaccine and Serum Research Institute

evidence.tested: RNA-seq plus ML-based coding-potential filters produced a first scorpion lncRNA catalog, including 12,642 transcripts without identifiable orthologs; this is a bounded transcriptomic result with computational rather than experimental validation.
